answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, directly addressing both revenue quality and sustainability. Memory 44 has strong relevance through superior enterprise pipeline quality, though it omits realized revenue, retention, and durability. Memories 31 and 86 show durable/early adoption improvements that are plausible leading indicators but do not establish qualified revenue or long-term retention. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the relevant price-sensitive SMB segment, but targeted promotional pricing may trade off against long-term revenue quality, and no retention, margin, or durability evidence is given. Memory 91 reports improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action only; it provides the weakest direct evidence for sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
